verses.ar: بِكَ يَارَبُّ ٱحْتَمَيْتُ، فَلَا أَخْزَى إِلَى ٱلدَّهْرِ.
verses.kjv: In thee, O LORD, do I put my trust: let me never be put to confusion.
verses.web: In you, Yahweh, I take refuge. Never let me be disappointed.

verses.ar: بِعَدْلِكَ نَجِّنِي وَأَنْقِذْنِي. أَمِلْ إِلَيَّ أُذْنَكَ وَخَلِّصْنِي.
verses.kjv: Deliver me in thy righteousness, and cause me to escape: incline thine ear unto me, and save me.
verses.web: Deliver me in your righteousness, and rescue me. Turn your ear to me, and save me.

verses.ar: كُنْ لِي صَخْرَةَ مَلْجَإٍ أَدْخُلُهُ دَائِمًا. أَمَرْتَ بِخَلَاصِي لِأَنَّكَ صَخْرَتِي وَحِصْنِي.
verses.kjv: Be thou my strong habitation, whereunto I may continually resort: thou hast given commandment to save me; for thou [art] my rock and my fortress.
verses.web: Be to me a rock of refuge to which I may always go. Give the command to save me, for you are my rock and my fortress.

verses.ar: يَا إِلَهِي، نَجِّنِي مِنْ يَدِ ٱلشِّرِّيرِ، مِنْ كَفِّ فَاعِلِ ٱلشَّرِّ وَٱلظَّالِمِ.
verses.kjv: Deliver me, O my God, out of the hand of the wicked, out of the hand of the unrighteous and cruel man.
verses.web: Rescue me, my God, from the hand of the wicked, from the hand of the unrighteous and cruel man.

verses.ar: لِأَنَّكَ أَنْتَ رَجَائِي يَا سَيِّدِي ٱلرَّبَّ، مُتَّكَلِي مُنْذُ صِبَايَ.
verses.kjv: For thou [art] my hope, O Lord GOD: [thou art] my trust from my youth.
verses.web: For you are my hope, Lord Yahweh, my confidence from my youth.

verses.ar: عَلَيْكَ ٱسْتَنَدْتُ مِنَ ٱلْبَطْنِ، وَأَنْتَ مُخْرِجِي مِنْ أَحْشَاءِ أُمِّي. بِكَ تَسْبِيحِي دَائِمًا.
verses.kjv: By thee have I been holden up from the womb: thou art he that took me out of my mother’s bowels: my praise [shall be] continually of thee.
verses.web: I have relied on you from the womb. You are he who took me out of my mother’s womb. I will always praise you.

verses.ar: صِرْتُ كَآيَةٍ لِكَثِيرِينَ. أَمَّا أَنْتَ فَمَلْجَإِي ٱلْقَوِيُّ.
verses.kjv: I am as a wonder unto many; but thou [art] my strong refuge.
verses.web: I am a marvel to many, but you are my strong refuge.

verses.ar: يَمْتَلِئُ فَمِي مِنْ تَسْبِيحِكَ، ٱلْيَوْمَ كُلَّهُ مِنْ مَجْدِكَ.
verses.kjv: Let my mouth be filled [with] thy praise [and with] thy honour all the day.
verses.web: My mouth shall be filled with your praise, with your honor all day long.

verses.ar: لَا تَرْفُضْنِي فِي زَمَنِ ٱلشَّيْخُوخَةِ. لَا تَتْرُكْنِي عِنْدَ فَنَاءِ قُوَّتِي.
verses.kjv: Cast me not off in the time of old age; forsake me not when my strength faileth.
verses.web: Don’t reject me in my old age. Don’t forsake me when my strength fails.

verses.ar: لِأَنَّ أَعْدَائِي تَقَاوَلُوا عَلَيَّ، وَٱلَّذِينَ يَرْصُدُونَ نَفْسِي تَآمَرُوا مَعًا.
verses.kjv: For mine enemies speak against me; and they that lay wait for my soul take counsel together,
verses.web: For my enemies talk about me. Those who watch for my soul conspire together,

verses.ar: قَائِلِينَ: «إِنَّ ٱللهَ قَدْ تَرَكَهُ. ٱلْحَقُوهُ وَأَمْسِكُوهُ لِأَنَّهُ لَا مُنْقِذَ لَهُ».
verses.kjv: Saying, God hath forsaken him: persecute and take him; for [there is] none to deliver [him].
verses.web: saying, “God has forsaken him. Pursue and take him, for no one will rescue him.”

verses.ar: يَا ٱللهُ، لَا تَبْعُدْ عَنِّي. يَا إِلَهِي، إِلَى مَعُونَتِي أَسْرِعْ.
verses.kjv: O God, be not far from me: O my God, make haste for my help.
verses.web: God, don’t be far from me. My God, hurry to help me.

verses.ar: لِيَخْزَ وَيَفْنَ مُخَاصِمُو نَفْسِي. لِيَلْبَسِ ٱلْعَارَ وَٱلْخَجَلَ ٱلْمُلْتَمِسُونَ لِي شَرًّا.
verses.kjv: Let them be confounded [and] consumed that are adversaries to my soul; let them be covered [with] reproach and dishonour that seek my hurt.
verses.web: Let my accusers be disappointed and consumed. Let them be covered with disgrace and scorn who want to harm me.

verses.ar: أَمَّا أَنَا فَأَرْجُو دَائِمًا، وَأَزِيدُ عَلَى كُلِّ تَسْبِيحِكَ.
verses.kjv: But I will hope continually, and will yet praise thee more and more.
verses.web: But I will always hope, and will add to all of your praise.

verses.ar: فَمِي يُحَدِّثُ بِعَدْلِكَ، ٱلْيَوْمَ كُلَّهُ بِخَلَاصِكَ، لِأَنِّي لَا أَعْرِفُ لَهَا أَعْدَادًا.
verses.kjv: My mouth shall shew forth thy righteousness [and] thy salvation all the day; for I know not the numbers [thereof].
verses.web: My mouth will tell about your righteousness, and of your salvation all day, though I don’t know its full measure.

verses.ar: آتِي بِجَبَرُوتِ ٱلسَّيِّدِ ٱلرَّبِّ. أَذْكُرُ بِرَّكَ وَحْدَكَ.
verses.kjv: I will go in the strength of the Lord GOD: I will make mention of thy righteousness, [even] of thine only.
verses.web: I will come with the mighty acts of the Lord Yahweh. I will make mention of your righteousness, even of yours alone.

verses.ar: اَللَّهُمَّ، قَدْ عَلَّمْتَنِي مُنْذُ صِبَايَ، وَإِلَى ٱلْآنَ أُخْبِرُ بِعَجَائِبِكَ.
verses.kjv: O God, thou hast taught me from my youth: and hitherto have I declared thy wondrous works.
verses.web: God, you have taught me from my youth. Until now, I have declared your wondrous works.

verses.ar: وَأَيْضًا إِلَى ٱلشَّيْخُوخَةِ وَٱلشَّيْبِيَا ٱللهُ لَا تَتْرُكْنِي، حَتَّى أُخْبِرَ بِذِرَاعِكَ ٱلْجِيلَ ٱلْمُقْبِلَ، وَبِقُوَّتِكَ كُلَّ آتٍ.
verses.kjv: Now also when I am old and grayheaded, O God, forsake me not; until I have shewed thy strength unto [this] generation, [and] thy power to every one [that] is to come.
verses.web: Yes, even when I am old and gray-haired, God, don’t forsake me, until I have declared your strength to the next generation, your might to everyone who is to come.

verses.ar: وَبِرُّكَ إِلَى ٱلْعَلْيَاءِ يَا ٱللهُ، ٱلَّذِي صَنَعْتَ ٱلْعَظَائِمَ. يَا ٱللهُ، مَنْ مِثْلُكَ؟
verses.kjv: Thy righteousness also, O God, [is] very high, who hast done great things: O God, who [is] like unto thee!
verses.web: God, your righteousness also reaches to the heavens. You have done great things. God, who is like you?

verses.ar: أَنْتَ ٱلَّذِي أَرَيْتَنَا ضِيقَاتٍ كَثِيرَةً وَرَدِيئَةً، تَعُودُ فَتُحْيِينَا، وَمِنْ أَعْمَاقِ ٱلْأَرْضِ تَعُودُ فَتُصْعِدُنَا.
verses.kjv: [Thou], which hast shewed me great and sore troubles, shalt quicken me again, and shalt bring me up again from the depths of the earth.
verses.web: You, who have shown us many and bitter troubles, you will let me live. You will bring us up again from the depths of the earth.

verses.ar: تَزِيدُ عَظَمَتِي وَتَرْجِعُ فَتُعَزِّينِي.
verses.kjv: Thou shalt increase my greatness, and comfort me on every side.
verses.web: Increase my honor and comfort me again.

verses.ar: فَأَنَا أَيْضًا أَحْمَدُكَ بِرَبَابٍ، حَقَّكَ يَا إِلَهِي. أُرَنِّمُ لَكَ بِٱلْعُودِ يَا قُدُّوسَ إِسْرَائِيلَ.
verses.kjv: I will also praise thee with the psaltery, [even] thy truth, O my God: unto thee will I sing with the harp, O thou Holy One of Israel.
verses.web: I will also praise you with the harp for your faithfulness, my God. I sing praises to you with the lyre, Holy One of Israel.

verses.ar: تَبْتَهِجُ شَفَتَايَ إِذْ أُرَنِّمُ لَكَ، وَنَفْسِي ٱلَّتِي فَدَيْتَهَا.
verses.kjv: My lips shall greatly rejoice when I sing unto thee; and my soul, which thou hast redeemed.
verses.web: My lips shall shout for joy! My soul, which you have redeemed, sings praises to you!

verses.ar: وَلِسَانِي أَيْضًا ٱلْيَوْمَ كُلَّهُ يَلْهَجُ بِبِرِّكَ. لِأَنَّهُ قَدْ خَزِيَ، لِأَنَّهُ قَدْ خَجِلَ ٱلْمُلْتَمِسُونَ لِي شَرًّا.
verses.kjv: My tongue also shall talk of thy righteousness all the day long: for they are confounded, for they are brought unto shame, that seek my hurt.
verses.web: My tongue will also talk about your righteousness all day long, for they are disappointed, and they are confounded, who want to harm me.
